changes.text: Corrected a rare case where Base rent became negative, and supergroups would be unable to pay rent. NOTE: It may take up to 24 hours after the build is published for rents to be corrected.
Corrected an issue where Tabs changed what channels they contain when a character zones
Upped duration of taunt effects on Stone Control/Animate Stone from 1 second to 13.2 seconds.
51 Month Veteran Badge will now correctly award the Pre-Order Blood Widow Helm. Please note that this helmet is only compatible with female models.
